m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (references/global-crew.md, references/global-everyone.md), the handoff at .agent-work/issue-58/crew-handoffs/g1-implement/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.md, and the cited DESIGN_SPEC.md sections. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff + design spec sections read; handoff verified complete

m1-verify-cycles.title: scripts/verify_cycles.py + tests/test_verify_cycles.py
m1-verify-cycles.imperative: Write scripts/verify_cycles.py: PASS (exit 0) iff >=1 cycle-*.json exists in .agent-work/<work-id>/ and every one is a survey with non-null consolidation; FAIL (nonzero, printed reason) on zero cycle files, unparseable JSON, or any cycle with consolidation: null. Follow verify_agent_feedback.py / verify_lessons_applied.py CLI conventions (argparse, work_id positional, printed reason on stderr, exit 1). Write tests/test_verify_cycles.py (unittest, tmp dirs) covering pass case, zero-cycles fail, unconsolidated-cycle fail.

postconditions.statement: verify_cycles.py exists and behaves per spec; targeted tests pass

constraints: single-purpose, no shared parsing module with verify_spec_confirmed.py

m2-verify-spec-confirmed.title: scripts/verify_spec_confirmed.py + tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py
m2-verify-spec-confirmed.imperative: Write scripts/verify_spec_confirmed.py per handoff section 2: parses Confirmation block (Status/Confirmed by/Date) and findings table (header ID | Lens(es) or Lens | Sev or Severity | Finding | Disposition | Reason, tolerant on Lens/Sev variants, strict on Disposition/Reason presence, empty = blank/whitespace). --phase review: PASS iff findings table exists with no empty Disposition cell (Status may be DRAFT). default/--phase confirm: PASS iff Status CONFIRMED, Confirmed-by and Date non-empty, no empty Disposition cells. Any phase: UNCONFIRMED marker (either hyphen variant) as a status/header line (not prose mention) prints loud refusal and FAILs. No findings table: FAIL both phases with clear message. Write tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py covering: CONFIRMED+full-table pass; DRAFT fail on confirm but pass on review when table complete; empty-Disposition fail both phases; UNCONFIRMED-marker fail; no-findings-table fail.

postconditions.statement: verify_spec_confirmed.py exists and behaves per spec; targeted tests pass
verifier PASSES against the live CONFIRMED DESIGN_SPEC.md (default phase)

constraints: single-purpose, no shared parsing module with verify_cycles.py
marker detection keys on status/header line, not any prose mention

m3-resolve-spine.title: resolve_spine generic <skill-dir> token + test_init_work_area.py extension
m3-resolve-spine.imperative: Extend resolve_spine() in scripts/init_work_area.py with a generic <skill-dir> token: when --skill-dir given, <skill-dir> resolves to it; when omitted, same auto-detect as commander token (<skill-dir>/scripts -> scripts when <root>/scripts exists, remaining bare token -> '.'). <commander-skill-dir> behavior MUST remain byte-identical. Only touch resolve_spine + its docstring/help. Extend tests/test_init_work_area.py additively: generic token resolves with and without --skill-dir; commander token unchanged.

postconditions.statement: resolve_spine handles <skill-dir> generically, <commander-skill-dir> byte-identical; targeted tests pass

constraints: EDIT only resolve_spine + its docstring/help in scripts/init_work_area.py

m4-full-suite.title: Full-suite green + evidence + commit
m4-full-suite.imperative: Run the full targeted pytest command and the full-suite pytest command from the handoff Verification Commands. Capture a red-case output example for each verifier. Commit the change on the current branch with a conventional message. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md at the handoff's Return Format path with all evidence pasted.

preconditions.statement: all three deliverables implemented and individually green

postconditions.statement: full targeted + full-suite pytest green; deliverable path check passes

check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_verify_cycles.py tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py tests/test_init_work_area.py -q && python -m pytest tests/ -q

constraints: git check-ignore scripts/init_work_area.py tests/test_init_work_area.py must exit 1
